evals.input_content:
Client Kick-off Call - Healthcare Platform - October 28, 2024

Present: Alex (Project Manager), David (Client Lead), Nina (Technical Lead), the client's CTO Sarah and product manager Tom.

We started by reviewing the project scope. The client wants to build a patient data management system with HIPAA compliance. Sarah emphasized that security and data privacy are non-negotiable. We discussed the compliance requirements and timeline. The first MVP should be ready in 8 weeks focusing on patient records, appointment scheduling, and basic reporting.

Next we covered technical architecture. Nina presented the proposed stack using a microservices approach with PostgreSQL and AWS. David asked about disaster recovery and backup strategy. We agreed to have a detailed infrastructure document ready by next Friday. Nina will own that.

The team also discussed the phased rollout plan. We'll have internal testing in weeks 1-6, client UAT in weeks 7-8, and then go-live. Sarah mentioned they need access to staging environment at the end of week 4 for their internal review. Tom said they need weekly status meetings to track progress.

Documentation and regulatory: We need HIPAA attestation, SOC2 documentation, and privacy policy. Alex will coordinate with legal team and create a compliance checklist by next Monday.

Decided: 1) MVP in 8 weeks 2) Weekly status meetings every Tuesday 3) Infrastructure spec by Friday 4) Staging access at week 4 5) Compliance documentation owned by Alex
evals.expected_output: Professional MoM with clear discussion groupings (scope, architecture, rollout, compliance), all decisions and action items in Outcomes section with owners
